# Queue as rate mismatch

`customer_support.mm.queue_management.queue_as_rate_mismatch` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **mental_model**

> A queue is a rate mismatch made visible, not a pile of work.

Reframing the pile as a gap between two rates changes every available action. You can lower arrivals, raise service rate, or accept the gap and choose who bears it — and only the third of those is achievable by asking people to try harder.
